The existing lab has 40 PCs and already uses the `kathara/base` image, which includes BIND. I propose using **pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) as the recursive resolver**; it is not assigned an authoritative zone.

The working specification is:

- Configure the 31 authoritative zones and 30 delegations exactly as mapped in your request, with SOA, NS, and required glue records. Each delegated zone’s apex A record will point to its assigned PC’s existing address.
- Configure pc32 to resolve recursively from the lab root on pc1 (`10.15.1.11`), without forwarding to external DNS servers. Point client resolvers to pc32.
- Set `www.example.com` to pc6’s address, `10.15.2.12`, as the assumed web-service address.
- Set `company.com MX 10 mail.company.com`, with the mail A record pointing to pc7 (`10.15.2.13`); set `university.edu MX 10 mail.university.edu`, with its A record pointing to pc11 (`10.15.3.13`).
- Preserve the existing links, IP addresses, routes, and device assignments. Store BIND configuration and zone files in the existing lab and start the services through the relevant startup scripts.
- After implementation, check zone syntax and verify delegation, recursive resolution, deeper names, and both MX records. Runtime validation will be a separate step.

No files have been changed. The [Kathara creation skill](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-pz43dx58/lab/.codex/skills/kathara-creation/SKILL.md) explicitly says, “Only start creating files after the user asks to create the scenario starting from the generated prompt.” Please ask me to implement this specification to proceed.
